items.title: 4.1.5.3 Task Scheduling using a Queue (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of task scheduling (PDF 104).

blocks.text: Task scheduling doctor ke clinic jaisi hai. Kaam mareezon ki tarah baari ka intezar karte hain; queue intezar ki list hai jo unhein aane ki tarteeb mein rakhti hai. Naya kaam aaye, maslan Print dabane par, to peeche enqueue hota hai; computer tayyar ho to aage wala kaam dequeue karta hai, jaise doctor agla mareez bulata hai. Queue yaqeeni banati hai ke kaam tarteeb se hon, koi chhoot na jaye, aur kaam kaarkardagi aur insaf se ho.

blocks.prompt: Computer ke job scheduling system mein queue kaise lagti hai, samjhaiye (short question 6).
blocks.explanation: Har aane wala job job queue ke peeche enqueue hota hai; jab processor ya aala farigh ho to scheduler aage wala job dequeue kar ke chalata hai. Is tarah jobs aane ki tarteeb mein chalte hain (pehle aao, pehle pao), koi chhoot nahi jata, aur nizam munsifana aur munazzam rehta hai.

items: Task scheduling: kaam aane par enqueue, computer tayyar ho to dequeue; pehle aao, pehle pao.
